searchText: We are speculating about a bright future, that may not be immediate. Someone submitted a manual PR to mark an EIP as stagnant. The EIP hadn't been touched for a year or two so I merged. Should I not have? If it is for over a year, it seems like a very good candidate for "Withdrawn". I suppose, it can be moved to "Withdrawn" by an EIP editor. It hardly even make grammatical sense for anyone but an author to withdraw their own proposal..
